Extract Dublin Core metadata tags

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><title>Scholarly Work</title><meta name=\"DC.title\" content=\"Principles of Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.creator\" content=\"Dr. Alice Johnson\"><meta name=\"DC.date\" content=\"2023-06-15\"><meta name=\"DC.subject\" content=\"Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.publisher\" content=\"Academic Press\"></head><body><p>This is a scholarly article.</p></body></html>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
